newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says Japan to intervene at right time -- Jiji.
newsitem.headline: MOF says Japan to intervene at right time -- Jiji.

text.p: Japanese monetary authorities will intervene in the foreign exchange markets when the timing is effective, Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Ministry of Finance's International Finance Bureau, was quoted as saying by Jiji news agency on Thursday.
"When we judge that there is really harm being done to the Japanese economy, we will conduct (intervention) when the timing is effective," Sakakibara was quoted as saying by Jiji.
It said he made the remarks at a meeting of a research committee of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP). The meeting was discussing foreign affairs.
